image_description: A close-up view of a blue adhesive bandage wrapped around a person's finger. The bandage features a cartoon character pattern (resembling Optimus Prime from Transformers) on a blue background. There is red ink writing on the skin adjacent to the bandage, and faint blue marker drawings are visible on the surrounding skin.

The point where the bandage overlaps itself lacks a clear physical boundary or shadow depth; it looks somewhat fused rather than layered.
The red writing on the skin resembles text but is illegible and structurally inconsistent, appearing as 'alien' script or melted characters, a common AI artifact when attempting handwriting.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the red writing on the skin. In real photos, handwritten ink is usually legible or clearly abstract scribbles. In AI images, it often morphs into pseudo-text that fails OCR. Also, inspect the bandage overlap: does it cast a realistic shadow on the layer beneath, or does it look like a single continuous texture map?
